name: Call Worm Spirit

source.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

text:
Frequency once per day

---
You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit. Choose an intersection on the ground within 60 feet; the ghostly maw of a worm emerges from the ground, attacking all creatures in a 10-foot burst. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 1d10+13 bludgeoning damage as it is battered by the worm's body.

Failure The target takes 3d10+15 piercing damage as it is bitten by the worm. The target is Immobilized until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but the damage increases to 6d10+30 bludgeoning and the target is knocked Prone.

---
Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The button above uses the better of your class or spell DC.
